title: iPhone 16 gets big price drop, details here
text:
iPhone 16 gets big price drop, details here 
 iPhone 16 gets big price drop, details here 
 By Armaan Agarwal 
 The iPhone 16 just got cheaper on Amazon. Here is what you get in this deal. 
 The iPhone 16 is listed right now for Rs 76,999, down from the list price of Rs 89,900. 
 On top of that, you can get another Rs 5,000 off with bank offers on the iPhone 16. 
 This brings the effective price of the iPhone 16 to Rs 71,999. 
 The iPhone 16 could be a nice pick at this price, especially when other phones have gotten more expensive. 
 Under the hood, the iPhone 16 is powered by the A18 chipset. In our review, the device was able to handle multitasking with ease. You can also have long sessions on games like COD Mobile. 
 The iPhone 16 comes with two cameras on the back – a 48-megapixel main, and a 48-megapixel ultrawide. We found that these sensors can provide you decent results with good consistency. 
 On the front, the iPhone 16 packs a 6.1-inch OLED display. The screen is quite bright with decent colours. But it is a 60Hz panel. 
 In our review, the iPhone 16 would usually last a day and some more on a single charge. You get USB-C and MagSafe support for charging.
